a/The 2015–19 category reflects 2019 percentages because these data were collected only in 2019.
b/Includes hanging, strangulation, asphyxia, anoxia, and other methods of reducing oxygen intake.
c/Includes all types of sharp force trauma or other injuries that cause acute loss of blood.
d/Includes drug overdoses and ingestion or use of other poisonous substances.
e/Includes self-inflicted blunt force trauma, dehydration, and unknown or unreported causes.
f/The BOP reported only the actual location of death, not where the suicide event occurred.
